question: Before the cut policy as it stands on main (r8: a result's tokens counted from its text, the proxy's breakpoint, tail pricing; thinking kept) goes out in a release: on every nine-turn task the bench has, what does a session cost, how many calls does it take and what does it pass with the cuts on, beside the same task run the same day with no proxy at all; and did each cut pay for itself by the end of its session?
rule: Chosen 2026-11-17 before the run, at the owner's ask for one larger benchmark before the release: every nine-turn task in bench/tasks (PostHog PR106936 and PR106672; MLflow PR26267, PR26269, PR26270, PR26300, PR26307, PR26311), none left out. Two arms paired by task, both run fresh: bare (straight to the API) and main-defaults (the shipped defaults behind a proxy of its own). One rep. PR26267 and PR26307 have no criteria and are judged by their check alone. 2026-11-18, at the owner's ask for three more tasks beside the long bug hunt: the thinking arm (cutThinking on, thinkingKeepTurns 2) on the three tasks whose no-proxy sessions of 2026-11-17 held the most thinking (PR106672 50k, PR106936 32k, PR26307 21k), one session each, beside those sessions. The lanes differ by the proxy's port alone.
